## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature should accomplish.

## Academic & DevOps Justification
How does this feature contribute to the DevOps evaluation criteria (Cloud, CI/CD, Observability, Autoscaling, Blue-Green Deployment)?

## Proposed Technical Implementation
- [ ] Infrastructure / Backend changes
- [ ] Frontend changes
- [ ] Tests and validation

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Automated tests written and passing
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] CI pipeline passes
